summaries.n-nvidia-ceo-scandal: Coins named for the Nvidia CEO story. The New York Times posted on X on 2026-11-08 that Nvidia opened an investigation into its CEO Jensen Huang after he acknowledged to the board a relationship with a business executive whom U.S. intelligence determined to be a Chinese spy. On 2026-11-11 The Wall Street Journal posted that Nvidia's board was preparing to oust him. On 2026-11-12 at 13:57 UTC Yahoo Finance posted that Huang had resigned as CEO and that CFO Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO; a Reuters post of 2026-11-13 calls him the former Nvidia CEO and says the Justice Department has not concluded whether the businesswoman, Alice Huang, was a spy. Dates from Codex: the Pump.fun Nvidia Spy pool opened on 2026-11-07, before the Times post; the LaunchLab one on 2026-11-08, nine minutes after it; Jensen Huang Coin and Jensen Hung on 2026-11-09; Next CEO of NVIDIA on 2026-11-12 at 05:58 UTC, before the resignation post; Stand With Jensen on 2026-11-13 at 22:07 UTC, after it.
